name: Osouji Daisuki! Cinderella
original_name: お掃除大好き！シンデレラ
source:
Cinderella meets a prince and a wizard and is invited to a ball. 
However, it seems that she is not interested in the ball if cleaning is more important. 
Can Cinderella really step out into the outside world ...?
